decision_status: frozen before inspecting the current refit results

selected_pipeline.selection_protocol: separate per-subject, per-finger three-fold event-grouped selection with a 95-bin purge around every held-out interval
selected_pipeline.ensemble: six random seeds per subject and finger

headline_policy: After integrity checks, replace the previous train-plus-validation headline with this pipeline's six-seed released-test result regardless of whether PCC increases or decreases.
acceptance_checks: all requested models completed without numerical failure
no member meets the predeclared training-only collapse criterion
predictions align with the intended subject and finger files
reported scores are computed from raw released glove trajectories
visual_review_role: Trajectory plots are used for diagnosis and reporting, not to choose whether to promote the result.
released_test_context: The current pipeline decision did not use its new released-test predictions. Before this protocol was fixed, however, the 2026 repository had used released-test labels to diagnose earlier models and compare saved runs; the final comparison is therefore retrospective.

subsequent_oof_routed_extension.selection_rule: promote a fixed joint ICA-wavelet plus CSP-band route only when it exceeds the better individual family in the same full-development event folds
